```{=html}
<div id="map-aug02" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug02').setView([33.4200, 126.6400], 11);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Jeju Airport', lat:33.48580289503151, lng:126.49091012883574, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Jeju+Airport' },
    { name:'Manjanggul Cave 🕍', lat:33.5280, lng:126.7718, c:'#5C6BC0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Manjanggul+Lava+Tube+Cave+Jeju' },
    { name:'Haenyeogimbap 🍱 (Gimbap by the sea)', lat:33.54253160461269, lng:126.6712426355821, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://share.google/Z42EE57KdOj3QE1oQ' },
    { name:'통일가든 🍜 (Cold Black Bean Noodles)', lat:33.534361533250895, lng:126.635465740889, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/gpRGRfnsbDUNPkGi7' },
    { name:'Jeju Stone Park 🗿', lat:33.449446919743444, lng:126.65897809190028, c:'#795548', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jeju+Stone+Park' },
    { name:'Eco Land Theme Park 🌳', lat:33.44753499655823, lng:126.667351143356, c:'#66BB6A', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Eco+Land+Theme+Park+Jeju' },
    { name:'Sangumburi Crater 🌿', lat:33.433231454404556, lng:126.6905560760605, c:'#2E7D32', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Sangumburi+Crater+Jeju' },
    { name:'Gyulbate Cafe 🍊', lat:33.28189285940979, lng:126.6298635374323, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://share.google/T7L5NKhJmMnZzilgk' },
    { name:'Ppolsaljip 🍖 (Dinner)', lat:33.250986428818536, lng:126.56288133558213, c:'#C62828', url:'https://share.google/3W40DafHqtsxpKfAx' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-02T09:00" data-lat="33.5280" data-lng="126.7718">
  <div class="event-time">09:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🕍 Cave</span><span class="tag note">⚠️ Check Status</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Manjanggul Lava Tube Cave</div>
    <div class="event-notes">One of the world's longest lava tubes — a UNESCO World Heritage site. Walk through a cathedral-like underground tunnel carved by ancient lava flows. The 7.4km tube has a 1km section open to visitors. <strong>Check reopening status before visiting</strong> — periodic closures for maintenance.
      <ul>
        <li>Temperature inside: ~11°C year-round — bring a light jacket</li>
        <li>Wear non-slip shoes</li>
        <li>Entry: ~₩4,000</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Manjanggul+Cave+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Manjanggul</a>

    </div>

</div>

    <div class="event-name">Jeju Stone Park (돌문화공원)</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Vast outdoor park celebrating Jeju's volcanic stone culture and mythology. Features hundreds of stone statues (dol hareubang), lava rock formations, and traditional thatched homes set across a sweeping landscape.</div>
